name: Asia Brewery
desc: Philippine brewer and beverage maker of LT Group, producing beer, alcomix, water, energy drinks and dairy, and distributing international beers.
products: Leon beer, Tanduay Ice, Cobra energy drink, Absolute water; distributes Asahi, Heineken, Tiger, Tecate
stores_or_sites: breweries in Cabuyao (Laguna) and El Salvador City (Misamis Oriental)

sponsorships.rights_holder: Cobra Energy Drink Iron Men (PBA D-League)

fit_rationale: Mass-market Philippine beverage maker with basketball heritage; F1 consumer promotions are possible for Cobra energy drink, but it distributes Heineken, an F1 partner.
customer_overlap: Distributes Heineken (current F1 partner) in the Philippines
category_conflict: potential: Heineken (F1 beer partner), which Asia Brewery itself distributes
outstanding: No revenue for Asia Brewery found; LT Group segment reporting not opened.

name: Alaska Milk Corporation
desc: Philippine dairy maker of Alaska, Alpine, Cow Bell and Krem-Top milk products, controlled by FrieslandCampina since 2012 and delisted that year.
products: evaporated, condensed and powdered milk, creamers
marketing_autonomy_basis: own brands and chairman from the founding Uytengsu family

alt_indicators.evidence: Alaska Football Cup, Alaska Power Camp, Alaska Ironkids triathlon, presenting partner of Jr. NBA/Jr. WNBA Philippines; former owner of PBA's Alaska Aces (to 2022)

fit_rationale: Strong sports-marketing heritage (basketball, football, triathlon) but a domestic dairy brand whose sports spend targets Filipino families and youth, not F1's audience.
outstanding: Only one Route C indicator found (sports sponsorship); no revenue or employees.
